name: Nowhere Safe
source: A woman in modern Japan finds herself terrified of leaving the house as she struggles with her less than favorable past.  When she finds a stranger staring into her living room window, she begins to struggle even more as she realizes that nowhere is safe.
translation: 在現代日本，一名女性因不堪過去帶來的陰影，害怕走出家門。當她發現有個陌生人正盯著客廳的窗戶時，恐懼進一步加劇，因為她意識到沒有任何地方是安全的。
